description: This file defines the syntax tree and parameter handling for sqlpage statement parameters, including the StmtParam enum, SqlPageFunctionCall struct, and functions for evaluating and extracting parameters from web request contexts.

classes.name: SqlPageFunctionCall
classes.description: Represents a call to a sqlpage function, including its name and arguments, with methods for creation, evaluation, and display.

methods.name: from_func_call
methods.description: Creates a SqlPageFunctionCall from a function name and arguments.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates the function call, extracting parameters from the request and database connection.

methods.name: fmt
methods.description: Formats the function call as a string for display.
